API Gateway: Feature (November 10, 2026)
changes.detail: TLS 1.3 for connections to backends API Gateway is rolling out support for TLS 1.3 on connections to backend services. Once the rollout reaches a gateway, it uses TLS 1.3 with backends that support it. No configuration is required.
